description.value: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study examined whether two weeks of varenicline attenuated neural responses to alcohol and food reward anticipation in heavy drinkers using the AFID task.

spans.text: In this double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized experimental medicine study, 29 heavy drinkers underwent a functional magnetic resonance imaging scan after 2 weeks of varenicline (2mg/d) or placebo administration.

description.value: Participants viewed an image signaling the chance to earn points toward an intravenous alcohol infusion. After a jittered 2000–6000 ms anticipation period, they pressed a button while a briefly presented target was visible to earn an alcohol point; they then viewed a win/loss outcome.

Participants viewed an image signaling the chance to earn points toward highly palatable snacks such as candy, chips, or granola bars. After a jittered 2000–6000 ms anticipation period, they pressed a button while a briefly presented target was visible to earn a food point; they then viewed a win/loss outcome.

spans.text: food (eg, candy, chips, or granola bars)

description.value: Participants viewed a neutral image signaling no reward. After a jittered 2000–6000 ms anticipation period, they pressed a button while a briefly presented target was visible, followed by a win/loss outcome, but no alcohol or food reward was available.

instructions.value: Participants viewed cues signaling alcohol, food, or no reward. After a jittered delay, they were instructed to press a button while a briefly presented white-square target was on screen to earn a point for the cued reward; after another jittered delay they saw whether they won or lost. They were told that earned food points could be redeemed for snacks after the scan and alcohol points would produce an intravenous alcohol infusion after the task.

spans.text: After a jittered period of time (2000–6000 milliseconds), participants saw a target (ie, a white square) and were instructed to press a button while the target was on the screen to earn a point for that reward type.
